scientific_limitations: Deterministic zero-additive-noise pair updates; the phase curve and singular law concern exactly two agents and positive exponential utility; universal hull preservation covers arbitrary finite populations only at or below the half-learning threshold. No stochastic steady-state or empirical claim.
title: Sharp convex-hull escape and singular consensus amplification in utility-weighted opinion dynamics
